assumptions.choice: Combine exit of current position and entry of opposite position into a single order of size abs(position.size) + UNITS
assumptions.reason: Spec requires closing existing position and opening new position on crossover. A combined order size executes both atomically on the next bar while strictly guarding pending orders.

assumptions.choice: Trading begins on the first EMA crossover event detected after indicator warm-up
assumptions.reason: Spec states 'Trading starts only after the first EMA crossover after the strategy is launched'. bt.ind.CrossOver evaluates to non-zero only when a true crossover event occurs.
Spec explicitly provides 10 000 units as the parameter example.
